selected_observations.excerpt: Oakfield rebranded in 2023 from Oakfield Logistics GmbH to Oakfield Logistik GmbH. Companies House / Handelsregister number HRB 88421 did not change. CRM still shows the old English-facing name.

selection_rationale: Explicit same-entity assertion for billing:Oakfield Logistik GmbH ↔ crm:OAK-77 must ground in authoritative prose, not mechanical name similarity alone.
known_missing_information: Pairs without explicit sameness language in commercial_notes may only support REJECT or UNRESOLVED, not ACCEPT.
